evals.name: new-widget-identity
evals.prompt: Create a new dashboard widget for a creator workflow.
must: design a unique signature functional component

evals.name: composition-math
evals.prompt: Design a two-column widget where one side has one component and the other has three stacked components.
must: include two gaps in the stacked total
use shared CSS variables or grid math

evals.name: bidirectional-resize
evals.prompt: Make a widget support more and less width and height without losing its identity.

evals.name: migrate-widget
evals.prompt: Standardize an existing custom widget with private controls and CSS.

evals.name: library-promotion
evals.prompt: A useful control exists only in the UI Reference Library.
must: promote implementation to production primitive layer

evals.name: mobile-header
evals.prompt: A portrait widget title and header toggle do not fit.

evals.name: dense-24px-row
evals.prompt: A row of 24px buttons clips labels on a narrow widget.
must: do not crop start/end of labels

evals.name: data-tool
evals.prompt: An analytics widget shows a useful signal but has no follow-up action.
must: avoid generic chat as the only AI interaction

evals.name: legacy-cleanup
evals.prompt: Delete the old widget skills now that the new skill exists.
